{{Top|leg}}
The '''Off-Worlders' Quarter Starport''' was located in the [[Off-Worlders' Quarter]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ropagi II]]. It was the point of entry for off-world visitors to [[Ropagi II]]. Customs checks were enforced for weapons only, and anything else was fair game. Each entrant had to convince the [[Ropagu]] [[Felis Alverite]] that they were planning to trade and seek knowledge rather than look for [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] work. Ropagi II's meager space force of six [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] were based at the starport, and [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] [[Leesa One-Eye]] maintained her office and private residence there.
